policy.purpose: Map every CEB primary metric to external observations without confusing metric resemblance with protocol equivalence.
policy.classes: exact_semantics means operational metric meaning aligns; close_semantics means same broad construct with specific definitional differences; related_but_distinct means useful contextual relation but not the same metric; not_comparable means no defensible numeric correspondence is registered.
policy.claim_rule: No direct superiority claim is allowed by this crosswalk. Even exact metric semantics is only eligibility for a matched test; separate preregistration must still match benchmark revision, tasks, instructions, source snapshots, model/harness, budgets, environment, adjudication and independent regrade.
policy.denominator_rule: Denominators and task units are attached to observations; a mapping never authorizes pooling separate splits or system configurations.
policy.empty_mapping_rule: An empty observation list with not_comparable is an explicit absence of an external comparator, not a missing validation record.
